home: A storm on {date} ripped part of the roof off the hay barn near {city}; the roofer's quote is {amount}.

The silo seal failed and roughly forty tonnes of maize silage spoiled before anyone noticed.

Heavy snow bent two trusses of the machine shed; the structural engineer's report is still missing.
Water from the overflowing ditch reached the ground floor of the farmhouse and the cold store next to it.
The small wind turbine on the yard lost a blade on {date}; it landed on the roof of the calf shed.
travel: The low-loader carrying the new potato harvester was held up at the border, and hiring a replacement cost {amount}.
{first} drove to the agricultural trade fair in Hannover; the stand materials were damaged on the way.
A pallet of seed potatoes stood on a hot quay for two days during transport to the buyer.

motor: The front loader arm of the tractor snapped while lifting round bales on {date}.
A combine harvester caught fire during the wheat harvest and the edge of the field burned as well.
{first}'s telehandler slid into the drainage ditch after heavy rain; a crane was needed to recover it, cost {amount}.
The quad bike used for checking fences hit a hidden stone and the front axle is bent.
A contractor's sprayer clipped the gatepost and scraped the side of the farm pickup.
The slurry tanker had a blowout on the provincial road near {city}, and the road had to be cleaned.
income: Late frost on {date} killed most of the blossom in the pear orchard; the expected yield loss is about sixty percent.
After the cooling tank broke down, two days of milk had to be discarded, roughly {amount} in lost sales.
The greenhouse heating failed for one night and the cucumber crop stopped growing for a week.
Waterlogged fields meant the sugar beet could not be lifted before the factory deadline.
The farm shop had to close for three weeks while the cold store was repaired.
A power cut on {date} stopped the milking robots for eleven hours and the yield dropped for days afterwards.
liability: Heifers broke through a fence on {date} and walked onto the main road; a passing van dented its bumper while braking.

{other_name}, a neighbouring grower, says spray drift from the tulip field damaged an organic carrot crop.

The farm's border collie was hit by a delivery truck on the yard and needed surgery at the vet.
A heat wave on {date} caused the loss of twelve fattening pigs in the old barn.

Bird flu restrictions meant the free-range hens had to stay indoors for eight weeks.
The draught horse used for the wagon rides went lame after stepping on a nail.
legal: The landowner wants to end the lease on two hectares of grassland a year early, and {first} disputes the notice.
A seed supplier delivered the wrong potato variety and refuses to refund {amount}.
The province is reclaiming part of a nature-management subsidy after a field inspection.
